newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish futop turnover rises 70 percent in June.
newsitem.headline: Danish futop turnover rises 70 percent in June.

text.p: Futures and options turnover on Denmark's Futop Exchange rose 70 percent in June from May 1997 to an average 3,804 contracts per day, the exchange said on Friday.
It said the total turnover for June was 76,089 compared to 44,638 in May.
At the same time total trade in bond-based contracts rose 226 percent to 2,385 contracts per day, it said.
Equity-based contracts fell five percent to a total 23,387 for the month of June, an average of 1,419 contracts per day.

Despite increased futures and options turnover in June, second quarter 1997 activity was down on the first quarter at an average 2,743 contracts per day, a 26 percent fall on a quarterly basis, the exchange said. --Ole Mikkelsen, Copenhagen newsroom +45-33969654
